facts.fact: 迷宫不是修整过的园林，而是果树与花篱杂乱密植成的墙，不靠人维护的小径连雀鸟都钻不进。
facts.anchor: The maze is not some tame, manicured construction, but composed of a messy assortment of fruit trees and flowering hedges

facts.fact: 瀑布从山背的冰川落下，先汇成湖，再跌下两级水池。
facts.anchor: The Errant Falls tumble down from the glacier tucked into the back of the mountain.

facts.fact: 土地的肥沃是祝福，也正是招来征服者觊觎的原因。
facts.anchor: It is our blessing, but it is also what drew the conquerors’ covetous gaze.

facts.fact: 两名税吏的尸体多处骨折，只有高处坠落能造成；他们的口袋里塞满苹果花。
facts.anchor: Also, their pockets were stuffed with apple blossoms.

facts.fact: 审问官那一族人升到有分量的位置就放弃本名，只用官衔。
facts.anchor: his people abandon their names when they achieve positions of consequence

facts.fact: 跟到瀑布的鬼只有两个，她看不出他是否能看见它们。
facts.anchor: Just two of his ghosts had followed him all that way

facts.fact: 国王派继承人来看税吏的案子，她此后再没回来。
森林神的祭司违背与她的地界约定，替审问官带路进山。
facts.anchor: I thought we had an agreement
